text: Women rarely say things directly, most of the time they communicate through behavior. If you focus only on what women say, you will stay confused. If you pay attention to what they do, things become much clearer. In this series, I'll break down common situations with women, what they usually mean, and how you should react if you want to keep your self-respect. So let's start with a very common situation. You matched with a girl on a dating app, or you met her at a party, in your class, at work, somewhere in real life. You exchange contacts, and you decide to text her. And then… Nothing. Hours go by, a full day goes by, sometimes even a few days. A lot of the guys immediately start making excuses for her. Maybe she's really busy, maybe she didn't see my message. But let's be honest, she most probably has her phone with her all the time. We all do. She almost certainly saw your message through the notification window. She just chose not to open it. Not because she's a bad person, but because opening it would mean engaging. And she doesn't feel like doing that. In simple terms, you are not that important to her. And that's not an insult, that's just information. The mistake a lot of men make at this point is trying to force interest where there is none. Sending follow-up messages, checking in, trying to be funny, trying to be understanding, trying to stand out. But interest doesn't work like that. If a woman is genuinely interested, you don't need to remind her you exist, you don't need to chase, you don't need to explain yourself. She replies because she wants to. The best course of action is just to move on and keep other options. Once again, if she would be interested, she would answer. That's not being bitter, that's just basic self-respect. Because the moment you start chasing someone who clearly isn't interested, you lower your value in your own eyes. And that never leads anywhere good. In the next video of this series, I plan to talk about a slightly different situation, when she does reply, but the interest is not very high. And what I am busy usually means.
